name: ArcelorMittal South Africa Limited
source: CRON 2026-10-14: H1 2026 column added from ArcelorMittal South Africa Limited Reviewed condensed consolidated results for the six months ended 30 June 2026, income statement, from arcelormittalsa.com (issued 30 July 2026). R million stored as absolute rand: Revenue 12,038; other income 190; raw materials and consumables used 5,935; energy 2,467; movement in inventories of finished goods and work-in-progress 877; employee costs 1,421; depreciation 304; amortisation of intangible assets 7; impairment of trade and other receivables 8; other operating expenses 1,929; loss from operations 720; finance and investment income 61; finance costs 707; fair value adjustment of investment properties and asset held-for-sale 113; income after tax from equity-accounted investments 8; loss before taxation 1,245; income taxation expense 2; loss for the period 1,247; basic and diluted loss per share 112 cents. Mapping: the issuer presents by nature and prints no gross profit line, so Cost of Sales is raw materials and consumables used plus energy plus the movement in inventories of finished goods and work-in-progress, and Gross Profit is revenue less that; Operating Expenses is employee costs plus depreciation plus amortisation plus the receivables impairment plus other operating expenses, and revenue plus other income less cost of sales less operating expenses equals the printed loss from operations of 720; Net Finance Costs is finance costs less finance and investment income, and loss from operations less that plus the fair value adjustment and the equity-accounted income equals the printed loss before taxation of 1,245.
